description: Canonical agentic pattern node from the WidgeTDC Pattern Composition Graph (ADR-008). Owned per ADR-007 cross-repo pattern lineage matrix: rlm-engine = reasoning + reflection patterns. Live corpus: 90+ :AgenticPattern nodes in Neo4j AuraDB, 89 embedded at 384D NEXUS canonical (LIN-818).

id.description: Stable pattern identifier with namespace prefix. Format: 'agentic-pattern:<slug>' or 'pattern:<slug>'. Used for cross-repo MATERIALIZED_IN edge keying per ADR-007.

description.description: 1-3 sentence description of what the pattern does and when to apply it. Used by embedPatternsCron to vectorize at 384D for srag.query semantic discovery.

summary.description: Optional short-form summary (one-liner) for SITREP and RAG inline use.

verdict.description: Adoption verdict from Gulli enrichment audit: 'adopt' | 'evaluate' | 'reject' | 'unverified'.

adoption_path.description: Suggested adoption recipe — when and how this pattern integrates into agent runtime.

score.description: Aggregate quality score (0.0-1.0). Composite of credibility + production-readiness + integration ease.

canonical_owner_repo.description: Per ADR-007 ownership matrix — which repo canonically owns this pattern (rlm-engine | orchestrator | contracts | WidgeTDC).

source.description: Provenance of pattern — academic paper, GitHub repo URL, internal harvest run, etc.

embedding_dim.description: Vector embedding dimension. Canonical: 384 (NEXUS, LIN-818). Other dimensions are orphan assets per Orphan Asset Lifecycle pattern.

gulli_chapter.description: Reference to Gulli reasoning-techniques chapter for cross-document anchoring (Phase Δ harvest).

gulli_credibility.description: Gulli-enrichment credibility score (very_low | low | medium | medium_high | high).

gulli_match_type.description: Type of match against Gulli corpus: 'exact' | 'semantic' | 'derived' | 'novel'.

gulli_strengths.description: Strengths from Gulli enrichment audit — array of bullet points.

gulli_weaknesses.description: Known weaknesses or failure modes from Gulli enrichment audit.

gulli_verdict.description: Free-text verdict paragraph from Gulli enrichment.

gulli_endorsement.description: Whether the pattern is endorsed by the Gulli reasoning-techniques source.

gulli_plan_id.description: Reference to the Gulli enrichment plan_id that produced this pattern record.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the pattern was first registered.

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 datetime of last content modification.
